posts.zh:
dsh-auto-vision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。为纯文本 DeepSeek Harness 主模型搭视觉桥：自动从已配置模型中挑选多模态模型，通过 vision 工具把图片描述以纯文本返回。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a0dfe9f9d6d08930817f.html
posts.en:
dsh-auto-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-discovery vision bridge for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: automatically finds an image-capable model from your configured providers and returns picture descriptions as plain text via a vision tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a0dfe9f9d6d08930817f.html
